program.name: LotusPROMIS-10
program.description: A 10-domain PROMIS profile collected in context groups on The Guide, with a milestone after every survey.
program.program_info:
About LotusPROMIS-10

LotusPROMIS-10 uses short Patient-Reported Outcomes Measurement Information System (PROMIS) forms covering physical, sleep, emotional, cognitive, and social health.

Surveys unlock in groups. After each survey you will see a milestone showing your progress and what comes next.

questions.title: Welcome
questions.description:
Welcome to LotusPROMIS-10

This program collects a short snapshot of how you are feeling and functioning, using 10 widely used PROMIS domains.

How it works

  • Surveys appear on The Guide in groups that belong together.
  • Finish a group and the next group unlocks.
  • After every survey you will see a milestone with your progress and what is coming next.

Most domains take about 1–2 minutes. There are no right or wrong answers — choose the option that feels closest.

questions.title: Are you ready to start LotusPROMIS-10?

options.text: I understand, start when I’m ready

questions.title: About this survey
questions.description:
Physical Function

These questions ask about your ability to carry out everyday physical activities.

How to answer

  • There is no 7-day time window for this domain — answer based on how you are now.
  • If ability varies, choose the option that best matches a typical day.

4 questions · about 1 minute

questions.title: Are you able to do chores such as vacuuming or yard work?
Are you able to go up and down stairs at a normal pace?
Are you able to go for a walk of at least 15 minutes?
Are you able to run errands and shop?
About this survey
questions.description:
Pain Intensity

This is a single 0–10 rating of pain, matching the PROMIS pain intensity item used in PROMIS profile instruments.

How to answer

  • Think about the past 7 days.
  • 0 means no pain. 10 means the worst pain imaginable.

1 question · under 1 minute

questions.title: In the past 7 days, how would you rate your pain on average?
About this survey
questions.description:
Pain Interference

These questions ask how much pain got in the way of daily life.

How to answer

  • Think about the past 7 days.
  • If you had no pain, choose Not at all.

4 questions · about 1 minute

questions.title: In the past 7 days, how much did pain interfere with your day to day activities?
In the past 7 days, how much did pain interfere with work around the home?
In the past 7 days, how much did pain interfere with your ability to participate in social activities?
In the past 7 days, how much did pain interfere with your household chores?
About this survey
questions.description:
Fatigue

These questions ask about tiredness and feeling worn out — not only sleepiness.

How to answer

  • Think about the past 7 days.
  • Include both how often and how strongly fatigue showed up.

4 questions · about 1 minute

questions.title: In the past 7 days, I feel fatigued
In the past 7 days, I have trouble starting things because I am tired
In the past 7 days, how run-down did you feel on average?
In the past 7 days, how fatigued were you on average?
About this survey
questions.description:
Sleep Disturbance

These questions ask about the quality of your sleep — falling asleep, staying asleep, and how refreshing sleep felt.

How to answer

  • Think about the past 7 days.
  • Answer about sleep itself, not how sleepy you felt during the day (that is the next survey).

4 questions · about 1 minute

questions.title: In the past 7 days, my sleep quality was
In the past 7 days, my sleep was refreshing
In the past 7 days, I had a problem with my sleep
In the past 7 days, I had difficulty falling asleep
About this survey
questions.description:
Sleep-Related Impairment

These questions ask how sleep (or lack of it) affected your daytime functioning.

How to answer

  • Think about the past 7 days.
  • Focus on daytime effects: concentration, irritability, getting things done.

4 questions · about 1 minute

questions.title: In the past 7 days, I had a hard time getting things done because I was sleepy
In the past 7 days, I had problems during the day because of poor sleep
In the past 7 days, I had a hard time concentrating because of poor sleep
In the past 7 days, I felt irritable because of poor sleep
About this survey
questions.description:
Anxiety

These questions ask about fear, worry, and feeling on edge.

How to answer

  • Think about the past 7 days.
  • Choose how often each statement was true for you.

4 questions · about 1 minute

questions.title: In the past 7 days, I felt fearful
In the past 7 days, I found it hard to focus on anything other than my anxiety
In the past 7 days, my worries overwhelmed me
In the past 7 days, I felt uneasy
About this survey
questions.description:
Depression

These questions ask about low mood, hopelessness, and feeling down.

How to answer

  • Think about the past 7 days.
  • There are no right or wrong answers. If you are in distress, talk with your care team.

4 questions · about 1 minute

questions.title: In the past 7 days, I felt worthless
In the past 7 days, I felt helpless
In the past 7 days, I felt depressed
In the past 7 days, I felt hopeless
About this survey
questions.description:
Cognitive Function / Cognitive Concerns

These questions ask about thinking, memory, concentration, and keeping track of what you are doing.

How to answer

  • Think about the past 7 days.
  • Answer about everyday thinking, not a formal memory test.

4 questions · about 1 minute

questions.title: In the past 7 days, my thinking has been slow
In the past 7 days, it has seemed like my brain was not working as well as usual
In the past 7 days, I have had to work harder than usual to keep track of what I was doing
In the past 7 days, I have had trouble shifting back and forth between different activities that require thinking
About this survey
questions.description:
Ability to Participate in Social Roles & Activities

These questions ask whether you could take part in family, work, leisure, and time with friends.

How to answer

  • Think about the past 7 days.
  • Never having trouble means you could do these activities as you wanted.

4 questions · about 1 minute · last domain in LotusPROMIS-10

questions.title: I have trouble doing all of my regular leisure activities with others
I have trouble doing all of the family activities that I want to do
I have trouble doing all of my usual work (include work at home)
I have trouble doing all of the activities with friends that I want to do
